import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Queue;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, w, next;

        public Edge(int to, int w, int next) {
            this.to = to;
            this.w = w;
            this.next = next;
        }
    }

    static int n, t, st = 210, ed = st - 1, cap[][] = new int[210][210], sci[][] = new int[210][210], maze[][][] = new int[210][210][210], head[] = new int[210], cnt;
    static boolean vis[][] = new boolean[210][210];
    static boolean dp[][][][][] = new boolean[210][210][210][210][210];
    static int b[][] = new int[][]{{0, 1}, {0, -1}, {1, 0}, {-1, 0}};

    static void addedge(int u, int v, int w) {
        Edge e = new Edge(v, w, head[u]);
        head[u] = cnt++;
        Edge e2 = new Edge(u, 0, head[v]);
        head[v] = cnt++;
    }

    static int d[] = new int[210], now[] = new int[210];

    static boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(d, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(s);
        now[s] = head[s];
        d[s] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = e.next) {
                int v = e.to;
                int w = e.w;
                if (d[v] != 0) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (w == 0) {
                    continue;
                }
                d[v] = d[u] + 1;
                now[v] = head[v];
                q.add(v);
                if (v == t) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dinic(int x, int t, int flow) {
        if (x == t) {
            return flow;
        }
        int rest = flow, i;
        for (i = now[x]; i != -1 && rest != 0; i = e.next) {
            int v = e.to;
            int w = e.w;
            if (w != 0 && d[v] == d[x] + 1) {
                int k = dinic(v, t, Math.min(rest, w));
                if (k == 0) {
                    d[v] = 0;
                }
                e.w -= k;
                e2.w += k;
                rest -= k;
            }
        }
        now[x] = i;
        return flow - rest;
    }

    static int solve(int st, int ed) {
        int ans = 0, flow;
        while (bfs(st, ed)) {
            while (flow = dinic(st, ed, Integer.MAX_VALUE)) {
                ans += flow;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int get_id(int x, int y, int k) {
        return (x - 1) * n + y + k * n * n;
    }

    static void dfs(int x, int y, int xx, int yy, int step) {
        vis[xx][yy] = true;
        dp[step][x][y][xx][yy] = true;
        if (step >= t || maze[step][xx][yy] != 0) {
            return;
        }
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            int nx = xx + b[k][0];
            int ny = yy + b[k][1];
            if (nx <= 0 || ny <= 0 || nx > n || ny > n) {
                continue;
            }
            if (vis[nx][ny]) {
                continue;
            }
            if (maze[step][nx][ny] != 0) {
                continue;
            }
            dfs(x, y, nx, ny, step + 1);
        }
    }

    static void init() {
        Arrays.fill(now, 0);
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        cnt = 0;
        for (int time = 1; time <= t; time++) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; x++) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; y++) {
                    if (maze[time - 1][x][y] != 0) {
                        maze[time][x][y] = maze[time - 1][x][y];
                    } else {
                        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                            int xx = x + b[k][0];
                            int yy = y + b[k][1];
                            if (xx <= 0 || yy <= 0 || xx > n || yy > n) {
                                continue;
                            }
                            if (maze[time - 1][xx][yy] == 2) {
                                maze[time][x][y] = 2;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (sci[i][j] != 0) {
                    Arrays.fill(vis, false);
                    dfs(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= t; i++) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; x++) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; y++) {
                    for (int xx = 1; xx <= n; xx++) {
                        for (int yy = 1; yy <= n; yy++) {
                            dp[i][x][y][xx][yy] |= dp[i - 1][x][y][xx][yy];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        String[] s = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(s[0]);
        t = Integer.parseInt(s[1]);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            s = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(s[j - 1].charAt(0))) {
                    sci[i][j] = s[j - 1].charAt(0) - '0';
                } else if (s[j - 1].charAt(0) == 'Y') {
                    maze[0][i][j] = 1;
                } else if (s[j - 1].charAt(0) == 'Z') {
                    maze[0][i][j] = 2;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            s = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(s[j - 1].charAt(0))) {
                    cap[i][j] = s[j - 1].charAt(0) - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        init();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (sci[i][j] != 0) {
                    addedge(st, get_id(i, j, 0), sci[i][j]);
                }
                if (cap[i][j] != 0) {
                    addedge(get_id(i, j, 1), ed, cap[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int x = 1; x <= n; x++) {
            for (int y = 1; y <= n; y++) {
                for (int xx = 1; xx <= n; xx++) {
                    for (int yy = 1; yy <= n; yy++) {
                        if (sci[x][y] != 0 && cap[xx][yy] != 0 && dp[t][x][y][xx][yy]) {
                            addedge(get_id(x, y, 0), get_id(xx, yy, 1), Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        pw.println(solve(st, ed));
        pw.close();
    }
